    Selection guide

    In Select / Pan, nearby edges take priority over interiors; smaller interiors win overlaps. Click a roof, yard or courtyard to inspect its property.                           Move a block

                          Click open ground outside properties in Select / Pan to change its district. Hide Buildings, Properties and Plots to target entire blocks.

                          Blocks can move only to an adjacent district. Neither neighborhood may become empty or disconnected.

                          Changes here create a draft. Rebuild city to apply it.

                          Water controls

                          Generate lakes, a river and a coastline independently, then edit each preview.

                          RIVER
                          Generation settings

                          River handles stay in order and nearby handles adjust to ease tight bends as you drag. Use Tidy river bends to repair tight bends in an older draft.

                          COASTLINE
                          Generation settings

                          Shoreline handles self-adjust like river handles. Use Tidy shoreline bends to repair an older draft.

                          LAKES
                          Generation settings

                          Up to eight independent lakes. Drag shoreline points to reshape; double-click a shore edge to add a point. Move lake uses its center marker.

                          Mountain controls

                          Generate editable mountain ranges around or inside the city.

                          Generation settings

                          Up to six ranges, inside or outside the outline. Footprint and ridge handles self-adjust. Buildings avoid steep ground; roads cross through designated passes. Keep mountains and water separated. Heights control map contours and peak symbols.
